reviews.title: App appears to be incomplete
reviews.text: This could be a great app if it allowed you to actually have a profile that’s more than just measurements. It claims that you can connect to Apple Watch but that the app is currently not compatible with Apple Watch. Generated reports do not have the correct dates on them even though you select the date range for the reports. Glad that I only paid for one week which I cancelled 2 days after I subscribed.
